name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.interpTabs_mem
typeText:
∀ (γ : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance) (n : Nat) [inst : NeZero.{0} n]
  (I :
    DisequalityDispersion.Interpretation (Fin (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.m γ))
      (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.arity γ) (Fin n)),
  Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.allTables n γ) (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.interpTabs γ n I)

source.code:
theorem interpTabs_mem (I : Interpretation (Fin γ.m) γ.arity (Fin n)) :
    interpTabs γ n I ∈ allTables n γ := by
  rw [mem_allTables]
  refine ⟨by simp [interpTabs], ?_⟩
  intro f hf
  have hf' : f < γ.m := by simpa [interpTabs] using hf
  rw [interpTabs_getElem γ n I ⟨f, hf'⟩]
  simp only [List.length_map, List.length_range, List.mem_map, List.mem_range]
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  rintro v ⟨e, _, rfl⟩
  exact Fin.is_lt _
